---
name: Bug report
about: Report an issue when using the server
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug-triage
assignees: ''

---

**Server type:**
Self-hosted/Connected to another player/Connected to community test server

**Issue date and time:**
YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm and your timezone from UTC (e.g. 2026-02-27 20:00 UTC+1), time can be approximate

**Server version:**
* If you connected to the community test server, specify community or leave blank
* If you connected to someone else's server, ask them to send you the version based on the next 2 points
* If you downloaded a release package from "Releases", specify its name (YYYYMMDD.<sequence number>)
* If you cloned the repository:
    1. Right click in the server folder and click on "Open Git Bash here"
    2. Type this into the command window and press enter:
    `git rev-parse HEAD`
    3. Copy the hash it provides and paste it here

**User ID:**
Your Steam username so we can check the logs for bugs

**OS:**
E.g. Windows 10]

**Issue description:**
Describe clearly and concisely what you were doing. What was the unexpected behaviour? If anything, what did you do that fixed or skipped the issue? Share screenshots and/or videos if you can.

**Issue Reproduction steps:**
Describe just the minimum and specific steps required to reproduce the issue described above
